result:
Hay Loop is added as the third track. Typecheck, the token check, the build and all 622 tests pass, including the existing every-track bot tests and six-car race tests, which now also run on Hay Loop.

**What changed**
- **Track file:** one new file, `src/content/tracks/hay-loop.json`: "Hay Loop", 3 laps, width 11. It uses only the existing prop kinds and changes no game code.
- **Shape:** a start straight, then an S-bend that turns 58° one way and 59° back. At the far end is a teardrop hairpin that turns 188° within 50 units. The narrowest gap between the hairpin's two legs is 26.5 units, so they never cross.
- **Back straight:** the return straight has one jump (6 long × 1.5 high), with its lip at 63% of the lap. A wide turn then leads back to the start.
- **Size and lap time:** the lap is 1179 units long. A single bot laps it in about 50–51 s; six-car races finish in about 155–158 s.
- **Props:**
  - hay-bale rows on the inside of the hairpin, and a short row at the S-bend;
  - tyre stacks on the outside of the hairpin and of the wide turn;
  - 22 cone trees in the infield, plus more along the outside.
- **Registry order:** the file sorts after `bends` and `dust-bowl`, so Bramble Bends stays first and NEXT RACE goes Dust Bowl → Hay Loop → Bramble Bends.

**Two fixes along the way**
- My first draft was about 4:1, much longer and flatter than the S6 thumbnail, so I spread the two long straights apart and shortened them to bring it nearer the thumbnail's proportions.
- In a six-car race, the last grid slot sat against the tyre stacks on the wide turn, so I ended that row earlier. Every grid slot is now at least 15.6 units from any prop.

**Which test covers each AC.** Each test fails when the track file is removed and passes with it.
- **AC1, AC2, AC3, AC6 and the infield part of AC7:** `tests/content/hay-loop.test.ts`.
- **AC4:** `tests/content/hay-loop-bot.test.ts`, with one run per seed shared by every check.
- **AC5:** `tests/content/hay-loop-bot.test.ts`, one test per seed 1–5.
- **AC7, race-scene props:** `tests/render/hay-loop-scene.test.ts`.

**Screenshots:** the Hay Loop race frames show the bale ring inside the hairpin, tyre stacks outside it and the whole loop on the minimap. No screen or UI code changed.

To show the new tests fail without the track, I briefly moved the JSON out. A cache in the scratch folder `node_modules/.vitest-cache` then kept serving the old two-track registry even after the file was back. I cleared that cache, and the final full run is clean.

No `design-request.md` was needed, since nothing came up that `UI_RULES.md` doesn't cover. `journal/` is mounted read-only in this sandbox anyway. No module was listed under "Supersedes", so nothing was deleted.
